title: Data for Canada - Orthoimagery Process Laboratory
description:
This repository provides systems-ready orthoimagery data for Canada, optimized for direct use in cloud-native geospatial applications and analysis pipelines. By standardizing diverse aerial and satellite imagery sources, it offers developers a consistent, high-performance visual baseline without the need for complex pre-processing.

As part of the Data for Canada project, this collection focuses on the 'Orthoimagery' theme, serving as a laboratory for open imagery processing and interoperability. For full documentation on the methodologies used, please visit https://www.dataforcanada.org/docs/processes/orthoimagery/ .
